metadata.description: Partial checklist for remaining properties in zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol

checklist.title: Verify totalTeleported strictly increases on each teleport
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate totalTeleported state variable in Verifier contract
2. Verify newTotal > currentTotal check uses strict inequality (not >=)
3. Confirm totalTeleported is updated BEFORE minting tokens
4. Verify totalTeleported is indexed by user/recipient address
5. Check that replay attacks fail due to monotonicity violation
6. Ensure no underflow possible in delta calculation

executable_checks.assertion: totalTeleported mapping and update logic exists
Monotonicity check rejects equal or lower values
Same proof cannot be reused after successful teleport

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CHECK-MONOTONICITY -> Edge EDGE-CHECK-MONOTONICITY. This is the PRIMARY double-spend prevention mechanism. Requires strict inequality (>) not (>=). Critical for protocol solvency.

checklist.title: Verify Groth16 proof cryptographically verified before token minting
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate proof verification call in teleport/withdrawWithProof function
2. Verify IRootDecider.verifyWithdrawProof or similar is called
3. Confirm verification occurs BEFORE any token minting
4. Check public inputs are correctly bound
5. Verify verification failure causes revert, not return false
6. Ensure verification key matches deployed circuit

executable_checks.command: Audit proof verification order in teleport function

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF -> Edge EDGE-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF. Cryptographic guarantee: Groth16 (128-bit). This edge ensures invalid proofs cannot result in unauthorized withdrawals.

checklist.title: Verify minted amount exactly equals delta from verified proof public inputs
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate where mint amount is derived in teleport flow
2. Verify amount comes directly from verified public inputs
3. Confirm delta = newTotal - currentTotal calculation is used
4. Check no user-controlled parameter can override proof delta
5. Verify no arithmetic errors in delta extraction
6. Ensure teleport() receives exact delta, not user-provided amount

executable_checks.assertion: Delta derived from public inputs, passed to teleport
teleport function signature visible for amount parameter
Minted amount matches exactly the proof delta

executable_checks.command: Trace data flow from proof verification to _mint call
executable_checks.assertion: No user-controlled override of mint amount

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-PROOF-VALID-CALL-TELEPORT -> Edge EDGE-PROOF-VALID-CALL-TELEPORT. Ensures exact minting - critical for supply conservation. Delta must be extracted from verified proof, not user input.

checklist.title: Verify Teleport event emitted after successful minting
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Teleport event definition in zERC20.sol
2. Verify event is emitted AFTER successful _mint call
3. Confirm event includes all relevant parameters (recipient, amount, rootIndex)
4. Check event emission is atomic with minting (no failures after mint without event)
5. Verify indexed parameters for efficient filtering

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport event is emitted in teleport function
Teleport event emitted with correct parameters

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TELEPORT-MINTED -> Edge EDGE-TELEPORT-MINTED. Event emission enables off-chain tracking and auditing of teleport operations.

checklist.title: Verify teleport reverts with RootNotFound for unknown roots
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate root validation logic in teleport function
2. Verify lookup in provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots
3. Confirm revert with custom error RootNotFound on lookup failure
4. Check zero value roots are not accepted
5. Verify error provides context (which root was not found)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-ROOT -> Edge EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-ROOT. Clear error messaging aids debugging and user experience.

checklist.title: Verify teleport reverts when recipient hash mismatches msg.sender
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate recipient hash validation in teleport function
2. Verify recipientHash = Poseidon(chain_id, msg.sender, tweak) computed on-chain
3. Confirm hash compared with proof's public input
4. Check revert on mismatch with descriptive error
5. Verify no way to bypass recipient binding

executable_checks.assertion: Attacker cannot use someone else's proof

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-BAD-RECIPIENT -> Edge EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-BAD-RECIPIENT. Critical for preventing proof theft and front-running attacks.

checklist.title: Verify replay attack prevention via monotonicity check failure
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify totalTeleported check prevents proof replay
2. Confirm replay has newTotal <= currentTotal (fails strict >)
3. Check custom error for double-spend attempt
4. Verify error provides sufficient context
5. Ensure atomicity - no partial state on failure

executable_checks.assertion: Same proof rejected on second attempt
Partial replay with lower total rejected

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-DOUBLE-SPEND -> Edge EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-DOUBLE-SPEND. Core double-spend prevention. Replay fails monotonicity check.

checklist.title: Verify cryptographically invalid proofs are rejected with clear error
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify Groth16 verifier reverts on invalid proofs
2. Check error propagation from verifier to Verifier contract
3. Confirm no try/catch that swallows verification failure
4. Verify custom error for invalid proof
5. Check malformed proofs (wrong length, invalid points) are handled

executable_checks.assertion: Random bytes as proof are rejected

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-PROOF -> Edge EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-PROOF. Groth16 soundness guarantees forged proofs fail verification.

checklist.title: Verify Adaptor validates all bridge parameters before proceeding
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate bridge request handling in Adaptor contract
2. Verify destination chain ID is validated against supported chains
3. Check slippage parameters are within reasonable bounds
4. Verify amount is non-zero
5. Confirm recipient address is valid
6. Check for reentrancy protection
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ADAPTOR-RECEIVES-REQUEST -> Edge EDGE-ADAPTOR-RECEIVES-REQUEST. Parameter validation prevents bridge failures and user confusion.

checklist.title: Verify Adaptor delegates unwrap to LiquidityManager without bypass
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate unwrap call in Adaptor bridge flow
2. Verify call to LiquidityManager.unwrap() is present
3. Confirm no direct token burn that bypasses LiquidityManager
4. Check returned underlying amount is used for bridge
5. Verify no duplicate unwrap possible

executable_checks.assertion: No direct burn in Adaptor (should not find)

executable_checks.command: Trace Adaptor bridge flow to verify delegation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ADAPTOR-UNWRAPS -> Edge EDGE-ADAPTOR-UNWRAPS. Delegation to LiquidityManager ensures consistent fee and validation logic.

checklist.title: Verify Stargate message sent only after successful unwrap
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Stargate send call in Adaptor
2. Verify send occurs AFTER LiquidityManager.unwrap returns
3. Confirm unwrap failure reverts entire transaction
4. Check event emission on successful bridge initiation
5. Verify atomicity of unwrap + bridge send
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-BRIDGE-INITIATED -> Edge EDGE-BRIDGE-INITIATED. Confirms cross-chain message sent only after local operations succeed.

checklist.title: Verify bridge failure triggers refund mechanism
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Understand Stargate failure modes (slippage, destination failure)
2. Verify refund address is set to user or Adaptor
3. Check Adaptor handles Stargate callback for refund
4. Confirm refunded tokens reach user
5. Verify no funds stuck in Adaptor

executable_checks.command: Review Stargate integration for refund handling
executable_checks.assertion: Failed bridges result in user refund
Slippage failure returns funds to user

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-BRIDGE-FAILED -> Edge EDGE-BRIDGE-FAILED. Critical for user fund safety. Reachability: REACHABLE_RECOVERABLE.

checklist.title: Verify verifier rotation requires admin AND emergency state
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate verifier rotation function in Verifier contract
2. Verify onlyOwner modifier is applied
3. Confirm isEmergency state check is present
4. Check both conditions are AND-ed (not OR)
5. Verify rotation updates verifier address(es)
6. Ensure old verifiers are properly invalidated
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-EMERGENCY-ROTATE-VERIFIERS -> Edge EDGE-EMERGENCY-ROTATE-VERIFIERS. Dual authorization (admin + emergency) prevents unauthorized changes.

checklist.title: Verify emergency deactivation requires verifier rotation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate deactivateEmergency function
2. Verify it checks that verifier addresses have changed
3. Confirm cannot deactivate with original (compromised) verifiers
4. Check event emission on deactivation
5. Verify state properly reset to non-emergency
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY -> Edge EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY. Ensures root cause is addressed before resuming normal operation.

checklist.title: Verify normal operation restored after emergency recovery
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify isEmergency flag is set to false
2. Check all emergency-blocked functions are re-enabled
3. Confirm new verifiers are active
4. Verify event emission for recovery completion
5. Check no residual emergency state
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED -> Edge EDGE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED. Verifies complete transition back to normal state.

checklist.title: Verify state machine completes emergency recovery cycle
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Trace state machine from emergency trigger to idle
2. Verify all intermediate states are reachable and exitable
3. Check no deadlock possible in recovery flow
4. Confirm state transitions are properly logged
5. Verify cycle can complete without external intervention (beyond admin)

executable_checks.assertion: Complete path from EMERGENCY to IDLE exists
Full emergency -> rotate -> deactivate -> idle flow works

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-BACK-TO-IDLE -> Edge EDGE-BACK-TO-IDLE. Ensures emergency recovery is completable.

checklist.title: Verify Nova circuit initialization loads correct parameters
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Nova proof generation initialization in CLI
2. Verify circuit parameters loaded from versioned files
3. Check parameter hash matches expected on-chain verifier
4. Confirm no parameter substitution possible
5. Verify circuit type matches intended operation

executable_checks.command: Review parameter loading and version checking

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-GEN-STATE-INIT -> Node STATE-NOVA-GEN-INIT. Parameter mismatch causes proof rejection on-chain.

checklist.title: Verify Merkle proofs fetched from indexer are verified in circuit
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Merkle proof fetching logic in CLI
2. Verify proofs are passed to Nova circuit as witness
3. Confirm circuit validates Merkle proofs against root
4. Check invalid proofs cause circuit failure
5. Verify proof format matches circuit expectation

executable_checks.command: Review circuit constraints for Merkle verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-FETCH-MERKLE -> Action ACTION-NOVA-FETCH-MERKLE-PROOFS. Cryptographic guarantee: Merkle proof + ZK. Invalid proofs from malicious indexer cause circuit failure.

checklist.title: Verify circuit parameters are loaded from trusted source with integrity check
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate parameter loading in Nova proof generation
2. Verify parameters come from trusted source (bundled or verified download)
3. Check hash verification of loaded parameters
4. Confirm parameters cannot be modified after loading
5. Verify error handling on parameter load failure
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-LOAD-PARAMS -> Action ACTION-NOVA-LOAD-CIRCUIT-PARAMS. Tampered parameters would cause proof rejection.

checklist.title: Verify witness data prepared from valid transfers only
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate witness setup in Nova proof generation
2. Verify witness derived from verified Merkle proofs
3. Check private inputs are correctly formatted
4. Confirm no external injection of witness data
5. Verify witness matches circuit expectations

executable_checks.assertion: Witness cannot contain fake data that passes circuit

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-SETUP-WITNESS -> Action ACTION-NOVA-SETUP-WITNESS. Fake witness data would fail Merkle verification in circuit.
